title: 数组中的最长山脉
summary: 山脉子数组先严格递增再严格递减，且长度至少三，求最长山脉长度。
insight: 一次扫描维护当前连续上升边数 up 和下降边数 down；平台或下降后重新上升会结束旧山脉并重置状态。
pitfalls: 必须同时有上升段和下降段
下降结束后遇新上升要清空旧下降和上升计数

solutions.title: 滚动上升下降边数
solutions.idea: 按相邻比较更新当前山脉状态。
steps: 若相等，或 down>0 后又上升，则 up=down=0
上升时 up++，下降时 down++；当 up>0 且 down>0 更新 answer=up+down+1

code.java: class Solution { public int longestMountain(int[] arr){int answer=0,up=0,down=0;for(int i=1;i<arr.length;i++){if(arr[i]==arr[i-1]||down>0&&arr[i]>arr[i-1]){up=0;down=0;}if(arr[i]>arr[i-1])up++;else if(arr[i]<arr[i-1])down++;if(up>0&&down>0)answer=Math.max(answer,up+down+1);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestMountain(arr:IntArray):Int{var answer=0;var up=0;var down=0;for(i in 1 until arr.size){if(arr[i]==arr[i-1]||down>0&&arr[i]>arr[i-1]){up=0;down=0};if(arr[i]>arr[i-1])up++ else if(arr[i]<arr[i-1])down++;if(up>0&&down>0)answer=maxOf(answer,up+down+1)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int longestMountain(vector<int>& arr){int answer=0,up=0,down=0;for(int i=1;i<(int)arr.size();++i){if(arr[i]==arr[i-1]||(down>0&&arr[i]>arr[i-1]))up=down=0;if(arr[i]>arr[i-1])++up;else if(arr[i]<arr[i-1])++down;if(up&&down)answer=max(answer,up+down+1);}return answer;} };
